# Design parameters
k <- 4  # observations per participant
marginal_sd <- 1
icc <- 0.4
group_diff <- 0.45
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.90

# Variance decomposition under random-intercept Gaussian model
# ICC = sigma_b^2 / (sigma_b^2 + sigma_e^2) where sigma_b^2 is between-participant, sigma_e^2 is within error
# Marginal variance = sigma_b^2 + sigma_e^2 = 1
marginal_var <- marginal_sd^2  # 1.0

sigma_b_sq <- icc * marginal_var
sigma_e_sq <- (1 - icc) * marginal_var

cat("Variance components:\n")
cat("  sigma_b^2 (between-participant) =", sigma_b_sq, "\n")
cat("  sigma_e^2 (within-participant error) =", sigma_e_sq, "\n")
cat("  ICC =", icc, "\n\n")

# Variance of participant average Y_bar_i
# Y_bar_i = mean of k observations from participant i
# Var(Y_bar_i) = Var(b_i + mean(e_ij)) = sigma_b^2 + sigma_e^2/k
var_participant_avg <- sigma_b_sq + sigma_e_sq / k

cat("Variance of participant average:\n")
cat("  Var(Y_bar_i) = sigma_b^2 + sigma_e^2/k\n")
cat("  Var(Y_bar_i) =", sigma_b_sq, "+", sigma_e_sq / k, "=", var_participant_avg, "\n\n")

# Pooled SD for two-sample t-test
# Under equal allocation and equal variances across groups
sd_participant_avg <- sqrt(var_participant_avg)

cat("Pooled SD for t-test:\n")
cat("  SD = sqrt(Var(Y_bar_i)) =", sd_participant_avg, "\n\n")

# Cohen's d effect size
cohens_d <- group_diff / sd_participant_avg
cat("Effect size (Cohen's d):\n")
cat("  d = group_diff / SD =", group_diff, "/", sd_participant_avg, "=", cohens_d, "\n\n")

# Use power.t.test for two-sample t-test
# power.t.test assumes equal variances and computes sample size per group
library(stats)

# First, search for the minimum integer sample size
n_candidates <- seq(20, 200, by = 1)
power_values <- numeric(length(n_candidates))

for (i in seq_along(n_candidates)) {
  n <- n_candidates[i]
  pwr_result <- power.t.test(n = n, delta = group_diff, sd = sd_participant_avg, 
                              sig.level = alpha, type = "two.sample", 
                              alternative = "two.sided")
  power_values[i] <- pwr_result$power
}

# Find minimum n achieving target power

if (length(idx_target) > 0) {
  n_min <- n_candidates[min(idx_target)]
  power_min <- power_values[min(idx_target)]
} else {
  n_min <- NA
  power_min <- NA
}

sigma_e_sq <- 0.6  # within-participant error variance

alpha <- 0.05
n_sims <- 5000

cat("Design: two-group RCT,", k, "observations per participant\n")

# Function to simulate and test one dataset
simulate_and_test <- function(n_per_group, mu_diff) {
  # Group 0: mean = 0
  # Group 1: mean = mu_diff
  
  # Generate data for group 0
  b_0 <- rnorm(n_per_group, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(sigma_b_sq))
  data_g0 <- data.frame(
    group = 0,
    participant = 1:n_per_group,
    y = rep(b_0, each = k) + rnorm(n_per_group * k, 0, sqrt(sigma_e_sq))
  )
  
  # Generate data for group 1
  b_1 <- rnorm(n_per_group, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(sigma_b_sq))
  data_g1 <- data.frame(
    group = 1,
    participant = (n_per_group + 1):(2 * n_per_group),
    y = rep(mu_diff + b_1, each = k) + rnorm(n_per_group * k, 0, sqrt(sigma_e_sq))
  )
  
  data <- rbind(data_g0, data_g1)
  
  # Compute participant averages
  participant_avgs <- aggregate(y ~ group + participant, data = data, FUN = mean)
  
  # Two-sample t-test on participant averages
  y_g0 <- participant_avgs$y[participant_avgs$group == 0]
  y_g1 <- participant_avgs$y[participant_avgs$group == 1]
  
  t_result <- t.test(y_g0, y_g1, var.equal = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")
  
  # Return p-value
  return(t_result$p.value)
}

# Function to simulate and test one dataset
simulate_and_test <- function(n_per_group, mu_diff) {
  # Group 0: mean = 0
  # Group 1: mean = mu_diff
  
  # Generate data for group 0
  b_0 <- rnorm(n_per_group, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(sigma_b_sq))
  data_g0 <- data.frame(
    group = 0,
    participant = 1:n_per_group,
    y = rep(b_0, each = k) + rnorm(n_per_group * k, 0, sqrt(sigma_e_sq))
  )
  
  # Generate data for group 1
  b_1 <- rnorm(n_per_group, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(sigma_b_sq))
  data_g1 <- data.frame(
    group = 1,
    participant = (n_per_group + 1):(2 * n_per_group),
    y = rep(mu_diff + b_1, each = k) + rnorm(n_per_group * k, 0, sqrt(sigma_e_sq))
  )
  
  data <- rbind(data_g0, data_g1)
  
  # Compute participant averages
  participant_avgs <- aggregate(y ~ group + participant, data = data, FUN = mean)
  
  # Two-sample t-test on participant averages
  y_g0 <- participant_avgs$y[participant_avgs$group == 0]
  y_g1 <- participant_avgs$y[participant_avgs$group == 1]
  
  t_result <- t.test(y_g0, y_g1, var.equal = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")
  
  # Return p-value
  return(t_result$p.value)
}
